ns2:section.sectionText: Online (asynchronous). This online studio course will introduce students’ to painting practices through the exploration of various theories, techniques, and themes. Class subjects will explore value and color, mixing acrylic and gouache paint, and a variety of mark-making techniques. Students will be required to have a remote place to paint, a digital camera for documentation, and a working computer with internet access. This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design.
